pricing.notes: roadtrippers.com/plus now redirects to /membership/. The plan table shows four tiers: Free, Basic $35.99/yr or $11.99/mo, Pro $49.99/yr or $16.99/mo, and Premium $59.99/yr or $19.99/mo. Premium at the annual rate is $5.00/month; the monthly rate is $19.99.
